body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on '2006 CES') -- <Visual News>
Altec Lansing has launched its new product ''inMotion iM11 portable audio system at CES 2006.
This made-for-iPod model provides high quality sound even without a subwoofer. Being less than 1 pound, this compact model is suitable for outdoor activities.
